title: Sort results with ORDER BY
description: Write a query that returns every product's `name` and `price`, sorted from most to least expensive.
hints: 💡 SQL concept to consider: ORDER BY
ORDER BY column sorts the result set - add DESC after the column to sort from highest to lowest instead of the default ascending order.
Select name and price from products, then ORDER BY price DESC.
expected_behavior: Returns name and price for every product, most expensive first.
solution: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC;
explanation: ORDER BY runs after the rows and columns are chosen - DESC (descending) reverses the default ascending sort, and ties (equal prices) keep whatever order the database happens to produce unless a second sort column is added.
